description.value: An imaging-genetics study examined whether GATA4 rs13273672 genotype modulates alcohol-cue-induced amygdala activation in abstinent alcohol-dependent patients.

value: We hypothesized that genetic variation in GATA4 rs13273672 contributes to inter-individual variability in alcohol-related neural functioning in the amygdala.
we expected G-allele carriers to show an increased relapse risk.
